metadata.description: Claude Code mods: a screenshot pane, quota on the status line, a ticket board, turn times, profile switching, and a couple of writing skills

plugins.name: screenshots
plugins.description: Shows PNG screenshots that agents read or push in a side pane, drawn inline with kitty graphics

plugins.name: quota-status
plugins.description: Status line: plan quota and time to reset (5h session, week), or dollars spent on API pricing, plus context window fill

plugins.name: scratch-board
plugins.description: Live pane of the specs and tickets in .scratch/, sorted by triage status and colour coded

plugins.name: turn-times
plugins.description: Clock time and how long ago (14:02 · 12 min ago) beside each prompt, reply and turn's end

plugins.name: import-session
plugins.description: Shows which Claude profile (config dir) you are in, and imports sessions for this project from your other profiles

plugins.name: linked-references
plugins.description: Every numbered reference (PR, issue, Jira or Linear ticket, commit) is a link, with its title when context doesn't say what it is

plugins.name: writing-for-slack
plugins.description: Messages written for pasting into Slack: raw markdown characters, - bullets, :name: emoji
